answer: Score every edge in the trust graph, then halve it each epoch the edge goes unused. Route attestations along the strongest path, so a cluster hiding behind one willow branch sends a weak signal across a wide canyon of unverified claims. Queue any disputed claim for a second panel drawn from the far side of the graph. Vest rewards over 30 epochs against future work, which means a farm that stops working watches its balance rot. Cheap, if you enjoy watching edges decay.
